page.layout: One title page, text set centred in the upper and middle part; the printed lines appear upside down on the scan. Below them a printer's imprint at the foot. A library stamp in the centre is left out, and an engraved vignette sits between the text and the imprint.
page.notes: The text is upside down and faint, so most lines are illegible or read only in part. The readings marked [?] or in ordinary letters are uncertain, and the Latin words are not checked. The Bayerische Staatsbibliothek stamp in the centre is excluded. The engraving between the text and the imprint is described here, not transcribed. The imprint at the foot is only partly legible: the place ROSTOCHII appears, and the printer's name and the date are not clear enough to copy.
